title: Ramesh Pillai v. Latha Pillai
text: The respondent-wife filed a counter-claim for divorce on the ground of cruelty in matrimonial proceedings initiated by the husband for restitution of conjugal rights. The court examined evidence of both parties. The husband's claim for restitution was withdrawn mid-trial. On the wife's counter-claim, the court examined several incidents of physical assault and verbal abuse documented in police complaint registers. The husband's conduct amounts to cruelty under Section 13 HMA. The parties have been in litigation for eight years, reinforcing the conclusion that the marriage has irretrievably broken down with no possibility of reconciliation. Under the principle of irretrievable breakdown as applied by the Supreme Court under Article 142 and followed by High Courts, the marriage is dissolved. Divorce is granted to the wife under Section 13 HMA. Alimony and custody matters to be determined in separate proceedings as agreed by the parties.
